simple.meaning: to be dumb ; by implication, to be astonished , to stop ; also to perish

definitions.full: H1826. damam I. [ דָּמַם ] verb be or grow dumb, silent, still (Late Hebrew id. ; Ethiopic in II. stupefy ; III., 1 & 2 be astounded, stupefied ) — Qal Perfect דַּ֫מּוּ Job 30:27 , דָּ֑מּוּ Psa 35:15 ; Imperfect יִדֹּם Amos 5:13 2 t., וַיִּדֹּם Lev 10:3 ; Josh 10:13 ; 3 feminine singular תִּדֹּם Lam 2:18 ; 2 feminine singular תִּדֹּמִּי Jer 48:2 (so Ki Ol & Kö 327 q. v.; others Niph`al); וָאֶדֹּם Job 31:34 : יִדְּמוּ Exod 15:16 3 t.; 1 plural cohortative נִדְּמָה Jer 8:14 (so Thes Ol Bö Kö 327q. see; others Niph`al); — 1 be silent Psa 4:5 ; Psalm 30:13; 35:15 (probably, compare De Che), Ezek 24:17 ; Lev 10:3 (P) Amos 5:13 ; in grief Lam 2:10 ; 3:28 . 2 be still (opposed to both speech and motion) Job 31:34 ; = perish Jer 8:14 ; 48:2 ; Psa 31:18 ( ׳ד לשׁאול ); with לְ be silent to i.e. be resigned to 37:7 ; 62:6 , followed by עֲצָתִי לְמוֺ Job 29:21 (|| שָֽׁמְעוּ לִי ); be still , motionless, stand still Josh 10:12-13 , (of sun || עמד ); 1Sam 14:9 (men); Jer 47:6 (of sword || הֵרָֽגְעִי ); so also of bowels, as seat of mental excitement Job 30:27 ; Lam 2:18 בַּתעֵֿינֵךְ אַלתִּֿדֹּם , i.e. cease not to weep (|| דִּמְעָה כַנַּחַל הוֺרִידִי ). 3 be struck dumb, astounded , in amazement and fear Exod 15:16 ( כאבן ) Isa 23:2 (but compare II. דמם ). Niph`al Perfect 3plural וְנָדַמּוּ consecutive Jer 25:37 ; Imperfect יִדַּמּוּ 49:26 ; 50:30 , יִדָּ֑מּוּ 1Sam 2:9 ; 2 masculine plural תִּדַּמּוּ Jer 51:6 — be made silent , i.e. destroyed; the wicked 1Sam 2:9 ( בַּחשֶׁךְ ), compare Jer 51:6 ; men of war 49:25 ; 50:30 ; dwellings 25:37 . Po. Perfect 1singular נַפְשִׁי וְדוֺמַ֫מְתִּי שִׁוִּיתִי Psa 131:2 ' composed and quieted my soul Che (as a weaned child). Hiph`il Perfect 3masculine singular suffix הֲדִמָּנוּ he (God) hath silenced us ( = caused to perish) Jer 8:14 . II. [ דָּמַם ] verb wail (?; compare Assyrian damâmu , groan, wail , lament , Dl Baer's Ezech xi; pr 64 ) — only Qal Imperative אִי ישְׁבֵי דֹּ֫מּוּ Isa 23:2 wail, ye coast dwellers (compare Dl l.c .), || הֵילִילוּ 23:1 , & אִי ישְׁבֵי הֵילִילוּ 23:6 ; most, however, assign this to I. דמם q. v.
